notes: Plex backup and restore: Settings → Your Plex library → Back up Plex makes a copy of everything you can edit in Plex (titles, descriptions, tags, posters, watched marks, library settings) and, if you like, Plex's own database file. It only reads from Plex. Restore puts a backup back into the same library or into a new one over the same folders, matched by file, with a preview first and Undo after. One Piece, the old-agent libraries and (into the same library) shows locked in AniBox each need an extra yes.
